data.long_meaning: Sunita is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Suni' which means 'radiant' or 'brilliant'. It is a name of the Sun God's consort, Sushila or Surya Devi, who is also known as 'Savitri'. In Hindu mythology, Sunita symbolizes the power of the sun and its life-giving energy. The name Sunita carries the meaning “Radiant, Brilliant” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Sunita usually hope their child will grow to embody radiant, brilliant and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sunita total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
